newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Air NZ sees steady international growth.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ sees steady international growth.

text.p: Air New Zealand Ltd said on Monday it saw steady international growth but heightened competition.
The airline earlier reported a 13 percent fall in net profit to NZ$225.2 million.

The expected restoration of the single Australasian aviation market arrangements and the company's prospective investment in Ansett Australia may provide stronger industry growth in Australia than New Zealand in the 1997 financial year, it said.
However, current intensive competition was expected to prevail in both the Australian domestic and international air transport markets.
With the New Zealand economy experiencing slower growth, there would modest, if any, expansion of the domestic aviation market.
